Package com.budgetapp.controller.features

Class GoalController

java.lang.Object
com.budgetapp.controller.core.BaseController
com.budgetapp.controller.features.GoalController
public class GoalController extends BaseController
Controller responsible for managing user financial goals. Handles CRUD operations and progress tracking for goals.
